query: What is the goal of ARIES recovery?

retrieved_chunks.chunk: ARIES recovers from a system crash in three passes.  - Analysis pass : This pass determines which transactions to undo, which pages were dirty at the time of the crash, and the LSN from which the redo pass should start. - Redo pass : This pass starts from a position determined during analysis and performs a redo, repeating history, to bring the database to a state it was in before the crash. - Undo pass : This pass rolls back all transactions that were incomplete at the time of crash.
